name: Pink 07 Hoodie — Washed Pink
description:
Heavyweight washed hoodie with a DTF back print: white "Final Heaven" script around a big white 07 with a black outline. A white three-star mark sits at the top middle of the chest, and "Final Heaven" is embroidered in white on both sleeves, just above the cuffs.

Heavyweight 350 g washed cotton with a snow-wash finish, relaxed unisex fit. Made to order, and the wash makes every one slightly different. European sizing: if you are between sizes, go one up.

supplier.name: Suning Sufang Yazhi Clothing Co., Ltd.

source.notes: Blank hoodie cost only (¥50, 350 g washed cotton). DTF and embroidery costs not confirmed, not included. fx 222.63 copied from the other hoodies on this blank (1688 screenshot, ₦34,508.13 / ¥155). Sizes S–XL assumed to match the other hoodies: European sizing, size chart not seen. Store return-rate label was cut off in the earlier screenshot (55.8%, unconfirmed). Photos are the owner's real blank with old prints removed by AI edit, real print files laid on top (brand/print/hoodie-07-pink). Back shot is the main photo.
